description: Read the Reddit, LinkedIn and X conversations the agents found for a workspace: threads, posts and comments where the user's business can genuinely help. Ranked by fit and heat. Use draft_reply to write an answer and update_opportunity to record what happened. Nothing is ever posted automatically.

agent.description: Which network: reddit, linkedin, x or all. Defaults to all.

limit.description: How many to return. Defaults to 10, max 50.

status.description: open = not yet answered, drafted = has a saved draft, replied = marked as answered. Defaults to open (which includes drafted).

name: list_opportunities
title: List conversations worth answering
